The terms of our culture should not be set by gate\-keeping legacy media or chaos\-fueling social media, but by the people who make and participate in that culture. Substack's model, based on direct subscriptions, has fueled an explosion of independent publishing. It empowers creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences.  

  

**About the Enterprise Team**  

Our team’s goal is to make Substack the default platform for the world’s most ambitious founders to build the media empires of tomorrow. We build features that help creators express their identity and brand, grow and understand their audiences, and run their businesses. We work closely with creators to understand their needs and turn those insights into features and reusable capabilities for the broader platform. Our work includes website customization, email automations, audience segmentation, analytics, external APIs, and more. You’ll take ownership of meaningful features while working closely with experienced engineers, designers, and product partners.  

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop features that help ambitious creators grow their audiences and businesses on Substack.
* Build custom websites and reusable tools that help publications express their identity and make customization faster and easier.
* Build audience tools that help publishers reach the right readers and understand what’s working.
* Collaborate with designers, other engineers, and external customers. From product concept and research to implementation and deployment, we expect you to own your work, with support and feedback from your teammates.
* We work with TypeScript, especially Node/Express and React, and Postgres. It’s helpful if you know these technologies already; if not, we’ll be excited to help you learn.

 **Requirements**

* 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience, including building and shipping web applications.
* Take initiative and ownership of your work, communicate clearly about progress and blockers, and know when to work independently and when to ask for help.
* Hold yourself and others to a high standard when working on production systems.
* Take pride in building elegant and delightful product experiences. Substack works best when it gets out of the way so writers can focus on writing and connecting with their readers.
* Enjoy collaboration with a diverse group of thinkers while bringing your own unique experience and background to the team.
* Believe in Substack’s mission to build a better business model for writing.

*Substack’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $260,000\. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.*


Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.


Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here.

jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Job Role:**
-------------


**Job Role: Site Reliability Engineer**


**Location: Boston, MA**


**Duration: Fulltime**


**Summary:**


We are seeking a highly motivated Site Reliability Engineer to help build and operate reliable, scalable, and secure services across our platform. This role is designed for someone who combines strong DevOps practices, modern SRE principles, and software engineering experience to improve system reliability, automate operations, and support high\-availability production environments.


The ideal candidate will be passionate about building resilient systems, improving developer productivity, and driving operational excellence through automation, observability, and engineering best practices. This role partners closely with engineering, platform, and product teams to ensure services are built for reliability from the start and remain performant, stable, and supportable at scale


**Key Skills** \- Node.js, Python, DevOps, Jenkins, AWS


**Preferred Qualifications**


* 9\+ years of demonstrated experience developing and designing products around Site Reliability Engineering principles to improve stability and platform availability for containerized workloads and on\-premises services using Kubernetes.
* Experience managing and interpreting large datasets using query languages and creating dashboards and reports with Power BI and Grafana.
* Strong background in managing cloud and on\-premises infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools, including Terraform, and CloudFormation.
* Hands\-on experience building, operating, monitoring, logging, and alerting distributed systems at scale using Datadog and Splunk.
* Experience supporting DevOps practices for service delivery and operations using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Team Foundation Version Control, and CI/CD automation.
* Experience developing software and automation solutions to support application delivery, operations, and repeatable business processes using Python.
* Knowledge of scalability and resiliency practices for applications deployed on AWS and Azure, including Lambda and API Gateway
* Strong development experience in scripting, automation, and integration across Linux and Windows\-based environments.

**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build and operate resilient, scalable systems using DevOps, SRE, and software development best practices.
* Deliver high\-availability services through automation, infrastructure as code, and proactive reliability engineering.
* Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability for distributed systems.
* Support CI/CD automation, deployment workflows, and production tooling to reduce operational toil.
* Drive incident response, root cause analysis, and recovery improvements to minimize downtime.
* Partner with engineering teams to embed reliability into the software development lifecycle.
* Automate provisioning, configuration, and self\-healing across cloud and on\-prem environments.
* Validate resiliency and performance through testing, chaos engineering, and capacity planning.'

jobs.title: Associate Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About Eulerity**



Eulerity is a rapidly growing technology company revolutionizing marketing automation for small businesses and franchises with our industry\-leading proprietary software. Founded by leaders from Google, Facebook, and Yahoo! with more than 20 years of digital advertising, engineering, and marketing experience, we build tools that make enterprise\-grade marketing accessible at scale.


### **The Role**



We're looking for a Backend Developer with 1–3 years of experience to join our engineering team. You'll take an active role in building, testing, and maintaining the backend services that power our platform — and you'll do it with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This is a role for someone who's genuinely excited about what AI\-assisted development makes possible and wants to push that further every day.


### **What You'll Do**


* Build, test, and maintain backend services across Eulerity's core platform
* Own features end\-to\-end — from design and implementation through deployment
* Use AI agents and LLM tooling to prototype, iterate, and ship faster
* Contribute product ideas and help shape the engineering roadmap
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams on features and releases
* Assist with documentation, system support, and knowledge sharing across the team

### **About You**


* 1–3 years of hands\-on backend development experience, with at least 1 year building in Java
* You've actually used AI agents (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to build, debug, and ship software — not just experimented with them
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI agent frameworks, or AI\-assisted development workflows
* Comfortable integrating third\-party APIs
* A strong drive to keep learning — especially when it comes to evolving AI tooling and how it applies to real engineering problems
* You think creatively about complex problems and enjoy finding elegant solutions
* A collaborative, communicative team player with a friendly, low\-ego approach

### **Requirements**


* Based in the NYC tri\-state area
* Available to work full\-time (40 hours/week)

### **What We Offer**


* Competitive salary (commensurate with experience)
* Full GitHub Copilot access with frontier LLMs and coding agents from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI — so you're always working with the best tooling available
* Mentorship and regular peer review sessions
* Unlimited snacks and an in\-office lunch credit
* Hybrid work flexibility with at least three in\-office days per week

### **Benefits**


* Comprehensive benefits
* + Medical
	+ Dental
	+ Vision
* ️ Unlimited PTO
* Commuter benefits
* 401(k) with company match
* Summer Fridays

### **Compensation**



Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company's size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, perks, and other opportunities at Eulerity. The expected total compensation range for this role is $95,000 \- $125,000, commensurate with experience.

Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world\-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.


Our team is dedicated to delivering end\-to\-end software support across all of Dandy’s product lines. Our teams collaborate across the company to ensure customers have an amazing experience at every stage: ordering, manufacturing, and support.


We are looking for motivated Software Engineering Interns to join our team. Our engineers have a high level of ownership, and you will have the opportunity to dive into unfamiliar code bases, debug real\-world processes, and help launch novel\-to\-industry products.

**What You’ll Do**


As a Software Engineering Intern at Dandy, you will:

* Contribute to building and maintaining core ordering flows used by our end customers every day.
* Work across any layer of the stack (frontend, backend, infra, data) to help ship end\-to\-end product experiences.
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, operations teams, and CAD designers to support the launch of innovative new products.
* Dig in and learn the intricacies of the dental restoratives market—you will know more about dentures than you ever imagined!

**What We’re Looking For**

* Currently pursuing an MS degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* Foundational experience in web development with an eagerness to work in a production TypeScript, React, and GraphQL environment.
* A high level of autonomy, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to comfortably navigate ambiguity and unfamiliar areas of a codebase.
* Familiarity with our specific stack (NestJS, TypeORM, Electron) is a bonus, but not required.
* Candidates must be able to reliably commute to the Dandy office in New York City, 3x days per week.

### **Why Join Dandy?**

* Work on real\-world healthcare problems with an immediate impact on our platform, customers, and manufacturing operations.
* Gain hands\-on, full\-stack experience at a fast\-growing startup alongside a world\-class technical team.
* Receive dedicated mentorship from experienced engineers who value ownership, speed, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Be part of a collaborative, NYC\-based team where innovation happens daily.

**Req ID:** J\-1285


For full\-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best\-in\-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW**

The kdb\+/q Developer will play a pivotal role in the early\-stage buildout of the kdb\+ platform, which is currently being shaped for the fixed income ETF desk and other trading groups. This position involves taking ownership of the real\-time and historical market data infrastructure, with an immediate focus on migrating the existing OneTick estate onto the kdb\+ tick architecture. As a full\-stack developer, you will manage every component of the stack, including tickerplant, RDB, HDB, gateways, feedhandlers, and the pricing pipeline.


The ideal candidate will have a strong background in kdb\+/q and will work closely with quant traders to understand their needs for pricing and trading. You will be responsible for designing and operating a multi\-terabyte HDB, maintaining feedhandlers, and ensuring the quality of the codebase. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain direct exposure to data, pricing models, and algorithms, while also providing a clear path to a permanent position for the right individual.


Location: NY


Pay: W2 $95


Contract Length: Initial contract with a clear path to a permanent position


**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Architect, extend, and harden the kdb\+ tick stack, including tickerplant, RDB, HDB, gateways, and feedhandlers.
* Lead the migration from OneTick to kdb\+, focusing on data model, historical backfill, feed cutover, user migration, and decommissioning.
* Maintain and occasionally extend feedhandlers for market data vendors such as Bloomberg B\-PIPE, MarketAxess CP\+, IHS Markit, and LSEG, as well as internal fair\-value feeds.
* Own the fair value and pricing data pipeline, along with the analytics that support it.
* Design and operate a multi\-terabyte HDB, managing partitioning, symbol management, compression, load balancing, and query performance at approximately 100 GB/day.
* Collaborate directly with traders and quants across the ETF desk and other groups to gather requirements, prototype solutions, and produce analytics; transform desk inquiries into robust, reusable q code.
* Oversee the release and deployment process for the platform.
* Provide production support for the data platform, including incident response and root\-cause analysis.
* Establish standards for code quality, testing, and documentation across the q codebase.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5\+ years of production experience with kdb\+/q in sell\-side or buy\-side trading infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of kdb\+/q, including the language, memory model, IPC, and performance optimization at scale.
* Strong foundation in software development principles, including testing, modular design, code review, and documentation.
* Comprehensive knowledge of tick architecture, including tickerplant/RDB/HDB topology, feedhandlers, gateways, entitlements, and log replay.
* Ability to write clean, well\-structured, and maintainable q code, focusing on quality over mere functionality.
* Proficient in Git and solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Capable of delivering high\-quality code in a fast\-paced trading environment, ensuring rapid deployment without compromising standards.
* Strong Linux and bash skills, with experience in running production processes, scripting operational tools, and debugging at the OS level.
* Experience working directly with front\-office users, demonstrating clear communication skills with traders under time pressure.
* Ownership mindset, comfortable being accountable for the platform end\-to\-end and navigating the ambiguity of a developing system.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Proficiency in kdb\+/q programming language.
* Experience with tickerplant, RDB, HDB, and associated architectures.
* Strong skills in Linux and bash scripting.
* Familiarity with cloud deployment of kdb\+, particularly on AWS, is a plus.

**PREFERRED**

* Exposure to cloud deployment of kdb\+ (AWS).

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other non\-merit factor. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees.*

jobs.title: Observability Platform Engineer (Datadog)
jobs.description:
Neuberger's Technology team is seeking an Observability Engineer to lead and evolve our observability strategy across cloud and on\-premises environments. You will serve as the primary owner and subject matter expert for our Datadog platform — building, scaling, and operating a comprehensive monitoring solution that continuously validates service health (24/7\) across business\-critical systems, including external websites and key infrastructure components (e.g., firewalls, OpenShift). You will design and implement end\-to\-end observability solutions spanning logs, metrics, traces, Service Level Objectives (SLOs), synthetic monitoring, and Real User Monitoring (RUM) to improve reliability, accelerate incident response, and deliver clear visibility into service performance.  

  

This is an individual contributor role with strong Datadog engineering and scripting expectations — not a pure administrator role, though prior admin experience is beneficial. You will partner closely with application, SRE/DevOps, infrastructure, and security teams and serve as the internal champion and evangelist for Datadog adoption, standards, and best practices. The environment includes an active migration from OpenView to Datadog, with workflows integrating into ServiceNow for incident routing and escalation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as the primary Datadog platform owner — architecting, building, and maintaining scalable observability solutions across cloud and on\-prem environments (Windows and Linux/Unix), with direct ownership of monitoring capabilities for key applications and services.
* Partner closely with application, DevOps, SRE/operations, infrastructure, and security teams to translate reliability goals into actionable Datadog monitoring strategies, dashboards, SLOs, and alerting frameworks.
* Lead and execute the migration from OpenView to Datadog, ensuring continuity of coverage and an improvement in monitoring fidelity across all migrated services and infrastructure.
* Develop and automate processes using Datadog's APIs, Terraform provider, and scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to manage monitors, dashboards, alerts, and telemetry configuration at scale — ensuring consistency across Windows Server and Unix (Linux/Solaris) environments.
* Implement and optimize Datadog APM, distributed tracing, log management, infrastructure monitoring, and Network Performance Monitoring (NPM) to provide full\-stack visibility.
* Build and evolve Datadog RUM and Synthetic Monitoring capabilities to track end\-user experience and proactively validate availability of external\-facing services and critical workflows.
* Define and operationalize SLOs and error budgets within Datadog; drive alert noise reduction through correlation, enrichment, threshold tuning, and monitor dependency mapping.
* Integrate Datadog with ServiceNow for incident/problem ticket routing and escalation; produce runbooks, post\-incident reviews, and executive/operational dashboards to support reliability reporting.
* Champion OpenTelemetry (OTel) adoption and drive consistent logging, metrics, and tracing standards across the engineering organization using Datadog as the central observability platform.
* Onboard new applications and services into Datadog; provide guidance and enablement to engineering teams on instrumentation, agent deployment, and observability best practices.
* Collaborate on platform cost optimization, data governance, and scaling strategies to ensure Datadog remains performant and cost\-effective as the environment grows.

**Required Skills and Experience**
----------------------------------

* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years in Observability, APM, SRE, or Platform Engineering — with at least 2–3 years of hands\-on, production\-grade Datadog experience.
* Deep expertise across Datadog's core product suite: APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Log Management, Synthetics, RUM, SLOs, Dashboards, Monitors, and Alerting.
* Proficiency in both Windows Server and Unix (Linux/Solaris) environments, including agent deployment, service instrumentation, and OS\-level performance analysis.
* Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, PowerShell, Bash) with hands\-on experience using the Datadog API/SDK and Terraform to manage observability configurations as code.
* Solid understanding of distributed tracing, metrics pipelines, logging standards, and SLO/error budget frameworks within Datadog.
* Experience integrating Datadog with cloud platforms (Azure and AWS) and centralizing cross\-environment telemetry.
* Demonstrated ability to reduce alert noise and MTTR through Datadog monitor tuning, correlation, and enrichment strategies.
* Experience with ITSM integrations (e.g., Datadog ServiceNow) and producing clear service maps, dependency views, and stakeholder\-facing dashboards.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical observability concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong documentation habits, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Datadog certifications (e.g., Datadog Fundamentals, APM, or Log Management).
* Experience migrating from legacy monitoring platforms (e.g., OpenView, AppDynamics, Nagios) to Datadog.
* Familiarity with .NET development (C\#), including Datadog instrumentation patterns for .NET applications.
* Experience in financial services or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with ITSM integrations and CMDB alignment for incident, problem, and change management workflows.
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration, synthetic testing strategies, and Datadog\-based performance/capacity analysis for latency\-sensitive systems.
* Knowledge of network monitoring concepts and Datadog NPM/NDM capabilities.

**About Us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

**The Job**
-----------


You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it.


Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers.


We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship.

**About You**
-------------

* You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals.
* You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience.
* You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity.
* You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents.
* You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs.
* You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast.
* You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem.
* You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale.
* Background in security, identity, or permission systems.
* Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks.
* Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers.
* Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell.
* Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

* Produce construction documents, specifications, and installation standards for low\-voltage cabling contractors.
* Define equipment placement within network rooms — rack elevations and positions for network gear, security and BAS panels, service wall fields, pathway and containment routes.
* Specify pathway, grounding/bonding, fire\-stopping, labelling, and testing requirements in line with TIA/BICSI standards and local code.

**Program and vendor delivery**

* Develop ROM and BOM for new builds and refreshes; drive procurement of long\-lead materials against project milestones.
* Oversee low\-voltage contractors through installation, ensuring work is delivered to design specification and quality standard.
* Issue Statements of Work and detailed working instructions to vendors; review and validate submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
* Walk construction projects on a regular cadence and issue written site reports capturing Client feedback, defects, and corrective actions.
* Manage punch\-list closure, acceptance testing, and test\-result review (fibre and copper certification) prior to sign\-off.

**Closeout and handover**

* Compile and record close\-out documentation — as\-built drawings, test results, warranty certificates, labelling schedules — and hand over to the operations team and end users.
* Ensure all newly delivered infrastructure is loaded into Netbox/Nautobot and CMDB before project closure.
* Conduct formal handover walkthroughs so operations inherit a documented, supportable environment.
* Capture lessons learned and feed improvements back into Client design standards and vendor specifications.

**Capacity and lifecycle engineering**

* Maintain a forward view of network room capacity — available ports, fibre strand counts, PDU outlets, rack units, and power headroom — and flag constraints ahead of demand.
* Plan and scope lifecycle refresh initiatives for cable plant, racks, and power infrastructure.
* Support regional power shutdown planning from an infrastructure design and risk perspective.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years in low\-voltage design, telecommunications consulting, IT construction project management, or structured cabling program delivery.
* RCDD certification (or actively pursuing) — this is the core credential for the design and specification scope.
* Working command of TIA\-568/569/606/607, BICSI TDMM practice, NEC low\-voltage provisions, and applicable local building and fire code.
* Ability to read and markup architectural, electrical, and telecom drawings; proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, or Bluebeam for review and redline.
* Demonstrated experience directing low\-voltage subcontractors and general contractors, including SOW authoring, submittal review, and change\-order control.
* Deep understanding of network room infrastructure — racks, containment, grounding, power distribution, cooling, and fibre/copper plant design.
* Strong written communication; able to produce specifications, site reports, and closeout packages to a professional standard.
* Comfortable operating with minimal direction in ambiguous, fast\-moving construction environments.

**PREFERRED**

* 10\+ years of related experience, including delivery of ground\-up building or large campus fit\-out projects.
* Additional BICSI credentials (DCDC, OSP, RTPM) or PMP.
* Experience delivering lab, cleanroom, or high\-density compute environments.
* Proficiency with DCIM/CMDB platforms, and with SQL, Python, or PowerBI/Tableau for capacity and program reporting.
* Prior experience at a large\-scale technology company or hyperscale operator.

**SERVICE MEASURES**

* Projects delivered to schedule and to design specification, with defects closed before handover.
* Design reviews completed within agreed turnaround at each project gate.
* BOM/ROM accuracy against final installed quantities.
* Complete closeout documentation and CMDB records at every project completion.
